description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mabodala, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510401
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property details. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles as defined in Type 4 classification.
